record.body:
## Description

From Needs you list or detail, dismiss human-dismissible items by calling adaptive-artifacts; refuse non-human kinds; keep the item and show an error when the CLI fails.

## Approach

1. Add a shared helper that maps kind to CLI: answered for questions, supersede needs none for findings, correct signed_by for unsigned manual checks; take store root from the dashboard target.
2. Bind dismiss on Needs you list and NeedsYouDetailScreen for human-dismissible kinds only; no-op or refuse for loop-route, integration, merge-branch.
3. On success refresh the snapshot so the item disappears; on failure leave it open and surface the CLI error in the UI.
4. Signer for manual checks: use a single configured default (env or constant) documented in README if needed.
5. Pilot-test dismiss for question, needs-human, and unsigned-check with CLI stub or temp store; assert refuse on merge-branch; assert failure keeps the item.
record.subject: dashboard-dismiss
